root_cause_evidence.repository_behavior: Both deploy scripts ran docker login without DOCKER_CONFIG while receiving the job-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN.
root_cause_evidence.external_contract: GitHub documents that GITHUB_TOKEN expires when its job finishes or at its effective maximum lifetime.
root_cause_evidence.temporal_match: The persistent Docker config mtime falls inside the successful Deploy to Dev job interval.
root_cause_evidence.conclusion: The workflow replaced the persistent host credential with a job token that was unusable after the job. The denied result does not prove that an earlier PAT expired.
